description: The historical 30-day annualised yield of TODAY’S eligible vaults: per asset class (stable, eth, btc, other) and week, the median and 90th percentile of the realised 30-day rate across comparable vaults of $1M or more, with n the vaults behind each point. An equal-vault median, NOT a portfolio return; vaults that closed or were refused are not in its past (survivor bias, `caveats`). A point under three vaults keeps its n and has null figures; under ten it is marked smallSample. `quantileMethod` names the interpolation (type 7). `members` lists the latest week’s vaults per class by slug with the capital they cover (tvlCoverage). The index takes `asset` only: leaderboard filters are ignored and named back in `ignoredFilters` beside `appliedFilters`. Early points rest on weekly readings and few vaults. FREE.
